thread:
alex: Quick sync — proposing an experiment to change routing precedence: prefer signed X-Client-Auth over User-Agent for tenant routing, but keep UA-derived sampling for telemetry. Reason: we saw ~0.7% misroutes when UA spoofed by some proxies. :eyes:

maria: Do we have repros or concrete log examples?

tyler: I pulled logs — 12 incidents in the last 2 weeks where tenant mismatch caused downstream 504s. snippet:
```
2026-03-12T14:22:01Z GET /v1/generate X-Client-Auth: - UA: curl/7.68
```

sophia: Are we sure the signed header is always present? some legacy clients don't send it.

alex: Not always. Plan: if X-Client-Auth is present and signature verifies -> route by it. Else fall back to UA heuristics. No change to quota attribution for the canary.

maria: How will this surface in console? ops need to debug which signal decided routing.

tyler: Proposal: add a routing_source tag to telemetry with values [auth_header, ua_infer, fallback]. Emit as log field + per-route metrics.

sophia: Security question — what if someone spoofs X-Client-Auth?

alex: We'll verify with our existing signer; if verification fails we treat it as absent (so no spoofing). Also increment auth_header_invalid metric.

maria: Rollout plan? metrics to watch?

alex: Canary: enable in us-west-2 for 5% traffic via console flag `hdr-priority-canary`. Monitor: misroute_rate, auth_header_invalid, p95 latency, quota-attribution-delta.

tyler: Also add a counter for `auth_header_missing` so we know how many clients don't send the header.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to region us-west-2 at 1766327905 — monitor dashboards.

sophia: Any SDK/client changes required?

alex: No breaking changes. SDKs can opt in to emit X-Client-Auth; we'll document `x-rd-signed-ctx` as an alternative header for proxies that strip unknown headers.

maria: Good call on alternative header. Please add docs and an example curl snippet.

tyler: I'll update telemetry dashboards and add a little console toggle mockup (shows routing_source breakdown per tenant). Will create PR for the routing rule + telemetry.

alex: Filed RFC PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/987 — please review, especially metric names.

maria: Reviewed — left two comments about metric naming and a nit on the console copy. :thumbsup:

sophia: +1 on canary, watch for quota attribution regressions.

alex: Thanks team. I'll start rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT and open a follow-up thread for post-canary results.
